claims.text: Indian-American Lawmakers Join 63 in Congress Urging Faster Green Cards as Health Coverage Lapses
claims.llm_reason: Article states Indian-American lawmakers joined 63 in Congress for faster green cards.

claims.text: A letter led by Reps. Clarke and Grijalva asks USCIS Director Joseph Edlow for an emergency I-485 expedite pathway after October 1 healthcare cuts left legally present immigrants uninsured while their green cards wait.
claims.llm_reason: Letter led by Clarke and Grijalva requests expedite pathway after healthcare cuts.

claims.text: Sixty-three members of Congress have urged USCIS to expedite green-card applications for legally present immigrants who are losing government-funded healthcare
claims.llm_reason: Sixty-three members urged USCIS to expedite green-card applications for immigrants losing healthcare.

claims.text: The congressional release put the number facing Medicaid loss from October 1 at more than 281,000 people across nine states and Washington, DC
claims.llm_reason: Article states over 281,000 people face Medicaid loss from October 1 across nine states.

claims.text: Indian-American lawmakers Raja Krishnamoorthi, Pramila Jayapal and Shri Thanedar were among the signatories
claims.llm_reason: Indian-American lawmakers Krishnamoorthi, Jayapal, and Thanedar are mentioned as signatories.
Yvette D. Clarke is mentioned as a leader of the letter.
Clarke is identified as a Democratic Representative from New York.
